Bug_Title: EC: equals(…) used to compare incompatible arrays (EC_INCOMPATIBLE_ARRAY_COMPARE)
Bug_Details:
This method invokes the .equals(Object o) to compare two arrays, but the arrays
of incompatible types (e.g., String[] and StringBuffer[], or String[] and int[]).
They will never be equal. In addition, when equals(...) is used to compare arrays it
only checks to see if they are the same array, and ignores the contents of the arrays.
Bug_Explanation: The equals method is used to compare two arrays of incompatible types. It only checks if they are the same array, ignoring the contents of the arrays.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case uses a String array and an Integer array to trigger the bug in the showBug method. The expected result of the comparison is false, but the buggy code will return true, causing the test case to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test case compares a String array with an Integer array using the equals() method, which is not allowed as per the bug rule. The test case expects the method to return false, but it does not, which indicates that the bug is present in the Java code.
